title: Rav Zevid, Father of Rabbi Shimon bar Zevid
author: Aharon Hyman

paragraphs: In [Berakhot 38a](https://www.sefaria.org/Berakhot.38a.16) the Rabbis praised to Rabbi Zeira the son of Rav Zevid, the brother of Rabbi Shimon bar Zevid. Hyman regards the reading cited in Dikdukei Soferim as straightforward and true, proposing “Rav Zevid, the father of Rabbi Shimon bar Zevid, for he is a great man and expert in blessings.” He said to them: “When he comes into your hands, bring him to me.” Once he came to him … he said, “Is this the one of whom they say he is a great man?” etc.

notes.text: The linked Gemara calls the guest the son of Rav Zevid and brother of Rabbi Shmuel bar Rav Zevid. The [continuation on 38b](https://www.sefaria.org/Berakhot.38b.1) explains why his blessing avoided taking sides. [Heilprin’s father-of entry](https://www.girsology.com/seder-hadorot.html?entry=1073&lang=en) records the father and brother descriptions alongside one another. Hyman endorses the father reading he cites from Dikdukei Soferim. The exact apparatus remains uncollated here.
